Fix by keeping the deadline and consequence ('chicago hub opens friday so levelers need installed by thursday or we miss the launch window and redo the whole schedule') and the push toward Miller ('miller is the only one that can hit that'), but drop the comparative line that spells out both vendors' lead times and draws the conclusion.
